ota.summary: Health + power: 'Last crash' shows what the node was doing before a crash or brownout; 'Power' shows Plugged in / Charging / Charged / On battery / Battery saver / Weak charger; battery % no longer reads high while charging; the halo breathes green when plugged in and amber when unplugged; safer empty-battery shutdown (no brownout reboot loops); 'Room comfort'. Includes the battery saver and pinhole reset from beta2.
